server.name: community-slimdex
server.version: slimdex-mcp (npm latest at image build time; v1.1.0 build 2026-11-03 observed)
server.note: Drawn in frame order at position 528 of Frame 3, block 5. Thirty tools; the server roots itself at its working directory, which is the trial root. Its bookkeeping under .slimdex (index.json, journal.json, stats.json, .gitignore and the timestamp-named snapshots/ copies taken before each edit) is projected away by declaration, so the comparison sees the source files, the client settings file install_hook writes, and the two documents the memory and digest tools own. The snapshot tool is not exercised for the same reason: its whole effect is a timestamp-named backup copy. memory.json and digest.json drop the generated id and the created and savedAt stamps; list lengths are kept.

arguments.text: retry the export only after reading the ledger

fixtures.note: Appends a fact to .slimdex/memory.json under a generated id. memory_search reads it back; its reply carries the generated id, so no stability is declared.
Two memory_save calls in one request, the F5 shape. Each lands as its own fact.
Deletes the fact seeded by setup under a fixed id, so the call needs no capture.

INSERT mode: adds a new function after alpha. The fixture prelude builds the index the anchor is resolved against; it calls a different tool and takes no fault. find_definition lists every definition site of the inserted name. probe_stable is set: the read tool's reply carries only file positions and source text, checked against its actual output.

REPLACE mode: overwrites beta's definition, resolved by name through the index built by the fixture prelude. probe_stable is set: the read tool's reply carries only file positions and source text, checked against its actual output.
Writes .slimdex/digest.json; the description says it overwrites the previous one.

Writes a PreToolUse hook into the trial root's .claude/settings.json. The project scope keeps the write inside the trial directory; the container's HOME is throwaway in any case. No read tool covers this file.
